messages:
cesar: Quick sync on MeridianBank POC. They want a 3-week trial focused on agent fraud assist + secure KYC ingest. Can we finalize scope + acceptance criteria by Fri?

nina: They also need SCIM for entitlement mapping and a proof of no PII leakage on ingestion. Potential blocker if SCIM requires Dedicated.

devon: Recommend MVP = fraud-assist + doc-ingest. Triage routing later. Need concrete endpoints so infra can estimate Dedicated vs hosted.

cesar: Draft acceptance criteria:
- /v1/fraud-assist -> returns {score, rationale, recommended_action}. Goal: precision >= 0.92, FP < 2%, p95 latency <250ms hosted, <200ms Dedicated.
- /v1/k-kyc-ingest -> OCR+fields+redaction. Goal: field F1 >= 0.99, redaction fail rate = 0 on 500-sample, throughput >=50 docs/min/GPU.

irina: Security asks: KMS customer-managed keys, VPC peering, HSM option, audit-log export. I'll need sample PDFs to run redaction tests + signed test-data NDA.

cesar: Pricing note for AE: suggest 3mo reserved discount ~10% + overage credits. Devon will confirm numbers with finance. Dedicated spin-up ~= 5 business days.

devon: I'll drop a tiny eval harness + sample prompt set. Example fraud prompt: "Wire $4,200 to new offshore payee; user denies auth. Return score(0-100), top reasons, recommended action." Eval metrics: action_accuracy, reason_consistency, hallucination_flag.

infra-bot: infra: created test org "meridian-poc", provisional API key issued (30d). Do not use real customer PII.

nina: I'll schedule alignment call with Meridian Thu 11am ET. Action owners: Nina = pricing/legal, Devon = eval harness+data (200 fraud cases, 300 docs) by Thu, Irina = redaction plan + sample request by Thu.

cesar: If owners confirm, I'll send the formal scope to Meridian. :thumbsup:
